categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies `test/functional/p2p_blocksonly.py` to fix the assertion checking that transactions are not announced to block-relay-only peers.
categories.rationale: Fixes a vacuous assertion in `p2p_blocksonly.py` that passed regardless of whether transactions were announced to block-relay-only peers. Because the peer negotiates wtxidrelay and the test transaction has witness data, announcements use the wtxid; checking txid meant the test could not catch unintended transaction announcements.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: The change is confined to a subsystem-specific functional test (`test/functional/p2p_blocksonly.py`) rather than the test framework or testing harnesses.
categories.rationale: Test infrastructure covers testing framework machinery and runners; tests that pin the behavior of a specific area belong to that area instead.
